description: Create a new activity template from a successful interaction pattern

task_steps.title: Identify Interaction Pattern
task_steps.description: Analyze successful conversations to extract reusable patterns
guidance: Look for recurring user intents that led to successful outcomes
Identify the key steps that made the interaction effective
Note which tools and context were most useful

task_steps.title: Define Activity Scope
task_steps.description: Determine what the activity should and should not cover
guidance: Keep activities focused on a single goal
Consider edge cases and failure modes

task_steps.title: Design Task Steps
task_steps.description: Break down the activity into discrete, measurable steps
guidance: Each step should have a clear completion criteria
Include appropriate guidance for agent behavior

task_steps.title: Create Activity Template
task_steps.description: Write the activity JSON following the schema
guidance: Set realistic cost and duration estimates
Start with status 'testing' for new activities

task_steps.title: Validate Template
task_steps.description: Ensure the template is valid and complete
guidance: Check all required fields are present
